source_text: Quicumque baptizati sumus in Christo Iesu, in mortem ipsius baptizati sumus. Consepulti enim sumus cum illo per baptismum in mortem, ut quomodo surrexit Christus a mortuis, ita et nos in novitate vitae ambulemus.
pass_a_gloss: Whoever we are who have been baptized into Christ Jesus, into his death we have been baptized. For we have been buried with him through baptism into death, that as Christ rose from the dead, so also we may walk in newness of life.
pass_b_english: [[All of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death >> Bible:Romans 6:3]]. [[We were buried with him by baptism into death, so that we too might walk in newness of life >> Bible:Romans 6:4]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
